individualCategoryReview.structure: SEBI March 20 2026 mutual-fund master circular describes Hybrid Long-Short Fund as an interval strategy with at least 25% equity/equity-related and at least 25% debt, and up to 25% unhedged short derivative exposure.
individualCategoryReview.categoryRisks: Derivatives and short exposures may amplify losses; equity, credit, interest-rate, liquidity and interval-redemption risks.
individualCategoryReview.investorAccessAndEligibility: Verify current SIF eligibility thresholds, investor onboarding, current ISID, strategy terms and distributor certification; no blanket retail approval.
individualCategoryReview.financialProfileScreening: Only where recorded profile shows short horizon, emergency liquidity need or constrained loss capacity, warn of instrument-specific liquidity and loss risk without ranking or inferred suitability.

verifiedPublicFrameworkFact.value: BIS publishes gold and refined bullion purity/assaying standards; no specific gold bar has been assayed or approved

preciousMetalsCategoryReview.structure: Physical gold bullion or coin; BIS refinery/mint voluntary hallmarking scheme covers gold bullion/coin, including 999/995 fineness, and is distinct from jewellery hallmarking.
preciousMetalsCategoryReview.categoryRisks: Spot-price volatility, authenticity/purity and custody/theft risks, dealer spreads and resale liquidity.
preciousMetalsCategoryReview.investorAccessAndEligibility: Verify actual bar/coin weight, assay/fineness, seller/refinery credentials, invoice, custody and lawful purchase access; do not treat BIS quality standards as investment authorization.
preciousMetalsCategoryReview.financialProfileScreening: Use only recorded short horizon, emergency-fund or limited-loss-capacity facts to show non-ranking volatility, liquidity and custody warnings. Do not infer eligibility or assign a product riskometer.

preciousMetalsCategoryReview.investorAccessAndEligibility: Verify bar assay, seller provenance, invoice, physical custody and local sale conditions; jewellery hallmarking is not proof of bullion certification.
